original: ○○、\n少しいいか？
traducao: ○○,\nDo you have a minute?

original: 折り入って頼みたい事が\nあるのだが……
traducao: I have a special favor\nto ask of you...

original: 実は、村に残してきた\n家族の事が気になっていてな
traducao: Actually, I've been worried about\nmy family back in the village.

original: いや、お前が想像している様な\n意味での「家族」ではない
traducao: No, it's not "family" in the\nsense you're probably imagining.

original: 身寄りのない幼い子どもを一人、\n俺が引き取って面倒を見ていたのだ
traducao: I took in a young orphaned boy\nand have been looking after him.

original: ギルドの仕事はまだ早いだろうと、\nあえて村に残したまま\nこちらに来てしまったが……
traducao: I left him in the village and came\nhere alone, thinking guild work\nwould be too early for him...

original: ここでは同年代の子どもも\n当たり前に仕事を請け負っている。\nそれを見て、少し考えが変わってな
traducao: But seeing kids his age taking\non jobs as a matter of course here,\nmy mind has changed a bit.

original: もちろん、都合の付く時で構わん
traducao: Of course, whenever you are free is fine.

original: 迎えに行くまでの道中、\n手を貸してはもらえないか？
traducao: Could you lend me a hand\non the way to pick him up?

original: クエスト「ちちんぷいぷいの魔法」が\nエントリーされました。\nユージーンから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "Chichin-puipui!" has been\nentered.\nYou can accept it from Eugene.

original: 手を貸してくれるか。\nすまないな
traducao: Will you lend me a hand?\nThanks.

original: あいつは自分の身を守る力は持っているが、\n何分まだ子どもでな。\nそれに、あの一帯は手強い魔物も多い
traducao: He has the power to protect himself,\nbut he is still just a child.\nAlso, there are tough monsters there.

original: 既にこちらへ向かっているとの事だが\n念の為、途中まで\nこちらからも迎えに行く事にした
traducao: He's already on his way here,\nbut just to be safe, I decided\nto go pick him up halfway.

original: 合流場所は、事前に俺から\n指示を出してある
traducao: I've already given him instructions\non where to meet us.

original: 行こう、○○
traducao: Let's go, ○○.

original: この火山で落ち合う事に\nなっているのだが……
traducao: We are supposed to meet\nat this volcano, but...

original: とりあえず、奥を目指そう。\n足場が悪い上に魔物も出る。\n気を付けて登るんだ
traducao: For now, let's head deeper inside.\nThe footing is bad and monsters appear.\nClimb carefully.

original: 大丈夫か？\nあまり顔色が良くないな
traducao: Are you okay?\nYou don't look so good.

original: ここの外気温は、他に比べ極端に高い。\nその温度差だけでも、ヒトの体には\n相当な負担になる
traducao: The temperature here is extremely high.\nThat temperature difference alone puts\na considerable strain on the human body.

original: 無理をせず、適度に補給と休憩を\n取りながら進んだ方がいいだろう
traducao: We shouldn't push ourselves. It's best to\nproceed while taking appropriate breaks.

original: ん？　ああ、マオ……。\nこれから合流する相手の事なら\n心配はいらん
traducao: Hmm? Ah, Mao...\nNo need to worry about\nthe person we are meeting.

original: どういうわけか、火の恩恵を\n強く受けて生まれた子の様でな。\n身体的には、多少の暑さはものともせん
traducao: For some reason, Mao seems to have been\nborn with a strong blessing of fire.\nPhysically, heat doesn't bother Mao much.

original: ふむ。\n恐らく出生に、何か秘密が\nあるのだとは思うが……
traducao: Hmm.\nI believe there's some secret\nregarding his birth, but...

original: 何ぶん、本人が過去の記憶を\n失くしていてな
traducao: The boy has lost all memories\nof his past.

original: 俺と会う以前の事を、\n全く覚えていないのだ
traducao: Mao remembers absolutely nothing\nfrom before meeting me.

original: なに、本人はあっけらかんとしたもので\n暗い部分など少しも見せん
traducao: Well, the boy himself is cheerful and\ndoesn't show a hint of darkness.

original: 強い子だが……それだけに\nいつかその緊張の糸が切れないかと\n心配に思うところもあってな
traducao: Mao is strong, but... because of that,\nI worry that the tension might\nsnap one day.

original: だが、ギルドで交友関係を広げれば\nあの子自身の幅も広がる。\nきっと、いい経験を積めるだろう
traducao: However, expanding his social circle\nat the guild will broaden his horizons.\nI'm sure he'll gain good experience.

original: もしかしたら、何かのきっかけで\n過去の記憶も戻るかもしれん
traducao: Perhaps something might even\ntrigger Mao's past memories to return.

original: そうか。\nそういえば、○○も\n過去の記憶が無いのだったな
traducao: I see.\nCome to think of it, ○○,\nyou also have no past memories.

original: こういう言い方は不謹慎かもしれんが……。\n○○とマオは\n親しくなれるかもしれんな
traducao: It may be insensitive to say this, but...\n○○ and Mao\nmight become good friends.

original: ……すまん。\n少しお喋りが過ぎた様だ
traducao: ...Sorry.\nI seem to have talked too much.

original: とにかく先へ進もう。\n合流地点までは、あと少しのはずだ
traducao: Anyway, let's move on.\nWe should be close to the meeting point.

original: あっ、ユージーン！
traducao: Ah, Eugene!

original: マオ。\n無事だったか
traducao: Mao.\nAre you safe?

original: うん。\n無事も無事、\nこの通りピンピンしてるヨ♪
traducao: Yeah.\nSafe as can be!\nI'm full of energy as you can see!

original: ○○、紹介しよう。\nマオだ
traducao: ○○, let me introduce you.\nThis is Mao.

original: ○○？\nって事は、キミが噂の……
traducao: ○○?\nDoes that mean you're the rumored...

original: ユージーンから話は聞いてるよ。\nこれから、よろしくネ♪
traducao: I've heard about you from Eugene.\nNice to meet you!

original: マオはまだ幼いが、\n術の使い手としては\nなかなかのものだ
traducao: Mao is still young,\nbut as an arte user,\nhe's quite skilled.

original: 今後、ギルドが請け負う仕事で\n役に立つ事もあるだろう
traducao: I'm sure Mao will be of use\nin the jobs the guild undertakes.

original: ボクは火の力を操るのが得意なんだ。\nこう、ちちんぷいぷい！　ってネ
traducao: I'm good at controlling the power of fire.\nLike this, chichin-puipui!

original: マオ。\n出来るからといって、\nあまり気安く力を使うのは感心せんな
traducao: Mao.\nJust because you can, doesn't mean\nyou should use your power so lightly.

original: ぶー。\nわかってるヨ
traducao: Boo.\nI know, I know.

original: とにかく、こういう力は\nヒトの幸せの為に使わないとネ♪
traducao: Anyway, this kind of power should\nbe used for the happiness of others!

original: ボクもギルドで精一杯頑張るから\n色々教えてね、○○！
traducao: I'll do my best at the guild too,\nso teach me lots of things, ○○!

original: おい、マオ？\nマオじゃねえか！
traducao: Hey, Mao?\nIt is Mao!

original: 何だよ、お前も結局\nこっちへ来たんだな！！
traducao: What, you ended up\ncoming here after all!!

original: うん。\nユージーンのお供がティトレイ一人じゃ\n心もとないからネ
traducao: Yeah.\nEugene would be uneasy with just\nTytree as his companion, right?

original: それに、ギルドって\n色んな人がいて楽しそうなんだもん♪
traducao: Besides, the guild seems\nfun with so many different people!

original: 遊びに来ているわけでは\nないんだぞ、マオ
traducao: You are not here\nto play, Mao.

original: 時には凶悪な魔物討伐の依頼を\n請け負う事になる事もある
traducao: Sometimes you'll have to take on\nrequests to subjugate vicious monsters.

original: くれぐれも\n気を引き締めていく様にな
traducao: Make sure to\nstay alert.

original: はーい
traducao: Yeees.

original: さすがのマオも、\nユージーンには頭が上がんねえな
traducao: Even Mao\nis no match for Eugene.

original: もう、うるさいヨ\nティトレイ！
traducao: Jeez, you're annoying,\nTytree!

original: ○○、\n色々と付き合わせてすまなかったな
traducao: ○○,\nSorry for dragging you around so much.

original: 協力してくれて助かった。\nありがとう
traducao: Your help was a lifesaver.\nThank you.

original: マオがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Mao joined Ad Libitum.
